blocks.text: Pontius Pilate. The governor who gave sentence on Jesus, told in all four Gospels.
Not given Governor of Judaea in the fifteenth year of Tiberius (Luke 3:1); no length is given.
“Matthew: they "delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor".”
ROME: 17 RULERS HEROD THE GREAT → PORCIUS FESTUS
Matthew: they "delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor". Matthew 27:2
All four Gospels have Pilate ask Jesus, "Art thou the King of the Jews?" Matthew 27:11 Mark 15:2 Luke 23:3 John 18:33
Pilate said he found no fault in him, yet released Barabbas and delivered Jesus to be crucified. Luke 23:4 Luke 23:24–25 John 18:38 John 19:16 Matthew 27:26 Mark 15:15
Luke: some told Jesus "of the Galilæans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices". Luke 13:1
Acts: Jesus was denied "in the presence of Pilate, when he was determined to let him go"; Herod and Pontius Pilate "were gathered together" against him. Acts 3:13 Acts 4:27 Acts 13:28
1 Timothy: Christ Jesus "before Pontius Pilate witnessed a good confession". 1 Timothy 6:13
